notes.title: 🔥 Virtual Cottage 2! 🔥
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38802078/67b70df74d88be7efe810e4e584282ba34f778af.jpg[/img][/url]

Dear Friends,

When we launched Virtual Cottage in October 2020 as our first game/app on Steam, we had no idea where it would lead us.

We initially intended to create a screen blocker to help you focus on your work and avoid distractions like social media.

However, over the years, you have all shared valuable ideas, feature requests, and ways you interact with Virtual Cottage. It became clear to us that a significant overhaul was due.

So, we're thrilled to present Virtual Cottage 2! It comes with three different timers (Classic Timer, Stopwatch, and Pomodoro) and an improved To-Do List (rearrange tasks, create categories, and set up repeating daily routines). This time, you’ll also be able to add your music. 

But now, the most requested feature of all time (we heard you loud and clear!): [b]Cottage customization[/b]. 

You will be able to choose between different room layouts in the beginning and add more as time goes by. The game will also offer a wide selection of furniture items to place inside your home. We wanted you to have the ability to create your ultimate cozy space! You will get rewarded one item (and its colour variations) per day, simply by using Virtual Cottage. And yes, there will be pets…this time, you won't have to choose between them—you can have them all active simultaneously!

We are super excited about this and hope you are as well!! 

If you wanna be up-to-date with the development or leave us some more input, you’re welcome to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/E2tR2mQ2KX]discord[/url] :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2

notes.title: Small update to fix a few things
notes.notes:
Hello cat lovers,

with this update we want to address:
- Korean localization
- CPU
- corrupted savegames

[b]Korean localization[/b]:
The errors pointed out by the community should now (hopefully) be fixed!
A huge thanks to [b]zeramise[/b] and [b]undefined[/b] who helped troubleshooting and worked on the translation sheet!

[b]CPU[/b]:
Cats Organized Neatly should now consume less CPU

[b]Corrupted savegames[/b]:
A few users have pointed out that their game progress was reset several times. Unfortunately this is very hard for us to reproduce. We did some changes to the way the game is saved and hope this might prevent this from happening again.

That's it for now - thanks for sticking with us!
In case you want to help with the translations or even add your own language, check out [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1scC5XGPo4nUJQVaLNajT68Qxv5i9GxcLkcOizyu-UfU/edit#gid=0]this sheet[/url]! :)

notes.title: Welcome to Cats Organized Neatly!
notes.notes:
We are very happy to tell you that Cats Organized Neatly is now translated into Korean!
For all the messages you’ve sent us, forum posts and of course reviews of the game we are extremely humbled and grateful. Thank you!

As with any translation, if you spot any quirks or errors, please let us know, so we can improve.

Cheers and enjoy puzzling!

EDIT: We are sorry to hear that the Korean translation we ordered does not seem to be a good one. It's super hard for us to "check" a translation for its quality, since we don't speak the language ourselves.
That's why we have now set up a Google Sheet where you guys can help us translate the game in basically any language if you want! \o/

Click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1scC5XGPo4nUJQVaLNajT68Qxv5i9GxcLkcOizyu-UfU/edit#gid=0]HERE[/url] to get to the sheet :D

notes.title: Update number three and more fixes :D
notes.notes:
Hey Cat organizers!

This is our third game update to adress a couple of the bugs and feature requests. 

- We implemented a very simple dark mode
- Iteration to the achievements code (regarding achievements triggering without the steam overlay)
- The Level Skip button should now (really) be disabled if you've already cleared a level 

Thank you so much for reporting bugs and being active on the forums!

notes.title: Update number 2!
notes.notes:
Hey Cat Organizers!

We fixed a few issues, that you brough to our attention over the last two days:

- Level 80, when completed, now gives you a gold star as well :D 
- Achivements should now also work when the steam overlay is not enabled (PLEASE let us know if this works)
- We fixed a few spelling errors in the cat introductions
- Achivement for chapter 3 was changed from "beat chapter 3" to "solve chapter 3"

Thank you all for being patient and reporting these bugs :)

notes.title: Hotfix regarding achievements not working properly
notes.notes:
Hello cat organizers!

Thank you for providing us with all the valuable feedback.

With this hotfix we want to adress the following:

[list]
[*] Achievements should now unlock for each completed chapter with no levels skipped in it. (e.g. you've played level 1 to 10 you should get the achievement for chapter one, but not if you skipped a level in between)
[*] F12 Steam Screenshots should now work
[*] For non 16:9 monitors the game will start in windowed mode, so that the cursor isn't offset. If you use the in-game option to change the game from windowed to fullscreen and back, the game should remember your setting
[/list]

A known issue is, that the social media buttons do not link to the correct websites for some users. We still couldn't figure out why that is, sorry!

Thanks everyone for using the Steam forums and reporting bugs and issues, we really appreciate it.

notes.title: I simply do not know where to put all of these cats
notes.notes:
It’s been of my understanding that getting cats under control is an impossible task. And yet, I thought I’d managed it with the help of Cats Organized Neatly. The delightful free demo had me thinking myself a master cat-wrangler right up until this massive dozing kitty slumbered its way into my life. With a free demo for the adorable pet puzzler out now, I am begging your help – where am I supposed to put this absolute unit of a feline?

(more…)
